description: Schedules a tattoo booking request for The Cocoon studio. Call this function when the caller provides all required booking details.
name: book_tattoo_appointment

caller_name.description: Full name of the person making the booking.

caller_phone.description: Contact phone number for the client.

design_description.description: Detailed description of the tattoo design concept.

ink_colors.description: Colors requested for the tattoo (e.g., Black and Grey, Full Color, Red).

placement.description: Body placement location for the tattoo (e.g., Forearm, Bicep, Ankle).

start_time.description: Requested appointment start time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2026-09-20T14:00:00).
